strategies.note: User installs a dedicated UNITY GitHub App and chooses repository scope. Installation credentials remain server-side.

OpenRouter redirects back with an authorization code; UNITY exchanges it server-side for a user-controlled API key and stores only a vault reference.
Use Vercel's external integration installation flow. The token stays server-side; bind one exact Vercel project read-only before any action is allowed.

rules: A website login is not an API authorization.
Redirect-based authorization must use state/PKCE or provider-equivalent anti-forgery protection.
Authorization callbacks exchange credentials only on the server.
Raw access tokens and API keys are written to the vault and never returned to the browser.
Provider scopes start read-only whenever the provider supports scoped authorization.
Unknown or unverified authorization methods fail closed.
